claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch for the named use case because aggregate readiness passed, rollout controls and monitoring are in place, and the remaining student-aid advising weakness is adequately handled if treated as a disclosed-risk launch.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows the policy threshold is satisfied.
The governing policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Rollout controls and monitoring mitigate risk but do not substitute for disclosure when the affected segment remains exposed.
A blank approver line and omission of the exposed segment mean the draft risk acceptance does not satisfy the policy predicate.
Actor conclusions cannot exceed what the admissible evidence actually establishes.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model card or equivalent launch artifact showing explicit disclosure of the student aid advising limitation for the named use case.
Provide approved risk acceptance only if the organization is relying on that exception instead of disclosure, and show that it expressly addresses student aid advising exposure.
Provide the final launch decision record tying certification to the disclosure condition, rather than a bare certify_model recommendation.
specific_concerns: The affected student aid advising segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The policy text says rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
The available risk-acceptance draft is not approved and does not address the exposed student aid advising segment.
The packet does not provide admissible evidence that the model card actually includes the required limitation disclosure for the named launch use case.

The recommended action is stated as certify_model, but the admissible support only reaches a narrower conclusion: certification is defensible only if the disclosure condition is actually satisfied before launch.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant without separate evidence showing the required model-card disclosure is in place.
Any implication that a 5% rollout, rollback switch, or monitoring alone cures the disclosure obligation.
Any implication that the existing risk-acceptance draft satisfies the policy exception.
